title: Cross-team clearance for Dedicated console: Model pinning + rollback UX, API, and legal guardrails
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Summary: This ticket coordinates cross-team reviews and sign-offs for the 'Model pinning' feature in the Dedicated console PRD. The feature lets customers pin a specific model version for a Dedicated capacity pool and surface an explicit rollback path. Engineering needs to finalize API surface and rollout strategy; Design must deliver accessible UX for pin/rollback, canary controls, and warnings; Legal must validate contract language for model pin guarantees and data residency implications. Goal: have a single, auditable acceptance artifact that contains engineering contracts, design mocks, legal caveats, test matrix, and rollback runbook before we start the release branch cut.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering: API contract doc (OpenAPI fragment + examples) reviewed and approved by infra and runtime teams
Engineering: Canary + rollback implementation tested in staging against Dedicated pool with automated smoke tests
Design: Figma mockups for pin modal, rollback flow, and confirmation states approved and accessibility checklist completed
Legal: Contract amendment language drafted for Dedicated customers describing model pinning liability and SLA implications; privacy and data residency confirmations included
Security: KMS integration and audit logging patterns validated and sign-off from Security Ops
Operations: Runbook for manual rollback and automated fallback thresholds published in Confluence
Telemetry: Cost/latency dashboards instrumented; alert thresholds and post-deploy metric checklist defined
Docs: Console help text, API docs, and admin changelog ready
Stakeholder signoff: explicit approvals from Eng (owner), Design (owner), Legal (owner), and Product (owner) recorded in this ticket
updates: 2025-02-12 — Ticket created. Initial PRD attached; asked ENG/DES/LEGAL for first-pass reviews.
2025-02-13 — ENG: Marco Liu flagged open question on KV cache interaction when pinning long-running sessions; assigned ENG-49210 to investigate.
2025-02-14 — DES: Evelyn Park uploaded first mocks (pin modal + confirmation). Requested copy changes to emphasize rollback implications.
2025-02-16 — LEGAL: Sophie Grant requested clause draft and a mapping of countries where model variant restrictions may apply due to data residency.
2025-02-18 — Product sync: Decided to require explicit customer acknowledgement when pinning models in regions with export restrictions. Added to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-20 — ENG: Implemented API prototype; uploaded OpenAPI fragment to the shared repo and linked below. Scheduling security review for 2025-02-24.
decision_summary: We will ship a developer-first pin UI in the Dedicated console that requires explicit acknowledgement from customers for regions with export/data residency constraints. Engineering will expose a stable 'pin_model' API endpoint and a 'rollback_to_previous' admin endpoint. Legal accepted the proposed contract language with a minor edit to SLAs clarifying that pinned models may have different availability characteristics; Security requires KMS audit logs prior to GA. Rollout will be phased: internal dogfooding -> limited customer opt-in -> broader rollout contingent on telemetry.
